acquisition_note: Transcribed rather than generated. Plan 5.1 classifies TMIW as generate-only because several of its tests build packets with Random() and assert against descriptor internals; the four RSC corpora do neither. They are literal TestPair lists, so transcription preserves the language-neutral guarantee D4 asks for at a fraction of the cost.
note: Stryd foot pod. Flags 0x80 sets a reserved bit with neither optional field present, so the packet is 13 octets of which only the first 4 are meaningful - a useful check that trailing bytes are ignored rather than misread. LIB-18c: the gait expectation key was renamed from "walking" to "running" to follow the Bluetooth SIG definition of flag bit 2 (0 walking, 1 running). Recorded values are unchanged: bit 2 is clear here, so the sensor reports walking and running is false. The earlier key encoded FitBridge's inverted reading, not a source fact.
